title: Study Buddy Architecture Explorer
description: The learner will identify the job of each of the five kit parts and of the buddy server by matching six described jobs to the correct part, with at least 5 of 6 correct.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
chapter_title: Personal Agents and the Open Study Buddy Architecture

educational.topic: Parts of the Open Study Buddy device and the buddy server
learningObjectives: The learner will identify the job of each of the five kit parts and of the buddy server by matching six described jobs to the correct part, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.pattern: Explore-then-retrieve network diagram with a click-the-part quiz
misconceptionsAddressed: The speaker and the amplifier are the same thing.
The buddy server is part of the desk device.
The Pico sends sound straight to the display.
pedagogical.assessment: Mastery is 5 of 6 job descriptions matched to the correct part on the first attempt.
pedagogical.defaultState: Opens at the first item with nothing answered; there is no animation or timer.
